title: Barren Island: India's Live Volcano

endcard.line: Pictures: NASA (public domain); Geological Survey of India, 1885 (public domain); 1789 drawing, unknown artist (public domain)

segments.say: A ring of grey rock in the Andaman Sea, about a hundred and thirty-eight kilometres from Port Blair. This is Barren Island.

anim.title: Barren Island
items: On a volcanic chain from Sumatra to Myanmar
The only active one on that chain

segments.say: It is the only confirmed active volcano in the Indian subcontinent, and the only live one on a chain of volcanoes from Sumatra to Myanmar.
The first recorded eruption came in seventeen eighty-seven. Travellers sketched the smoking cone soon after.
Then, after a few more eruptions, it went quiet for nearly a hundred and fifty years. Geologists still came to survey it and draw it.
In nineteen ninety-one it woke again, and that eruption lasted six months. More eruptions followed, some seen from space.
So the record runs from seventeen eighty-seven, through a long sleep, to repeated eruptions in our own time.
For Prelims, remember: Barren Island, in the Andaman Sea, is India's only confirmed active volcano.

sources: Wikipedia, 'Barren Island (Andaman Islands)' (which cites the Smithsonian Global Volcanism Program and the Geological Survey of India): only confirmed active volcano in the Indian subcontinent and the only active one on the Sumatra–Myanmar chain; about 138 km north-east of Port Blair; first recorded eruption 1787, further eruptions in 1789, 1795, 1803–04 and 1852; nearly a century and a half of dormancy; 1991 eruption lasting six months; eruptions 2017–2019

reviewNote: Facts were read against the Wikipedia article on Barren Island, which cites the Smithsonian Global Volcanism Program and GSI. The GVP page itself showed a verification wall to this computer, so check the eruption list on volcano.si.edu (vn=260010) before approval. Moving facts: eruptions continue (the summary lists one in 2025), so the script says 'repeated eruptions in our own time' rather than a latest date.
